reason: A third-party Electron desktop client for DSH focused on persistent local task execution, desktop notifications, runtime management, and plugin marketplace workflows; the README also documents agent command and file access, warranting R2 risk.

summaries.zh: 一款面向 DSH 的第三方 Electron 桌面客户端，提供托盘常驻、后台任务、通知、运行时连接以及插件市场管理。
summaries.en: A third-party Electron desktop client for DSH that provides tray persistence, background tasks, notifications, runtime connections, and plugin marketplace management.

capabilities: Provides an Electron desktop interface for the DSH web UI
Keeps local DSH tasks running in the background after the main window closes
Connects to or starts local DSH runtime processes
Supports system notifications and selected desktop integrations
Allows agents to execute commands and access user files through the DSH runtime
Provides a plugin marketplace with review prompts and plugin installation or removal workflows
Connects to DeepSeek APIs through the DSH runtime
